title: Avocado Egg Toast
description: Creamy avocado spread on toasted bread with perfectly cooked eggs and sautéed veggies
ingredients: red chili flakes, salt, black pepper
instructions: Heat a little olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and bell pepper and sauté until softened; season with salt, pepper, and chili flakes.
Crack the eggs over the veggies, add more seasoning, top with spinach, and cover. Steam until the eggs reach your preferred doneness.
Toast the bread. Mash the avocado with salt, pepper, and chili flakes, then spread onto the toast.
Place the cooked eggs and veggies on top. Add cheese if you like.

title: Sooji Besan Cheela
description: A quick savory pancake made with semolina and chickpea flour
ingredients: salt, turmeric, red chili powder, black pepper
instructions: Mix sooji, besan, and yogurt in a 1:1:0.5 ratio, adding water gradually to make a loose batter (sooji will thicken as it absorbs water).
Add chopped onion, coriander, green chili, and spices.
Spread each scoop of batter on hot greased pan like a dosa, cook until golden brown on both sides.

title: Honey Lemon Chicken
description: Chicken drumsticks with honey lemon glaze
instructions: Marinate chicken drumstick with salt and pepper for like 10 mins. Also cut deep slits in each drumstick
After heating oil in a pan, cook drumsticks on all sides for 8 mins. Should get some browning
Combine honey, lemon juice, garlic, salt, & a splash of soy sauce. Pour into pan. Add bit of water as well
Cover pan and cook for 10 mins. Finish with some cilantro optionally. Serve with rice.
